title: Appeal filed before Supreme Court against Dressage team selection for Asian Games 2026
description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday agreed to urgently hear an appeal filed by two dressage riders against the Delhi High Court's refusal to interfere with India's Dressage team selection for the 2026 Asian Games despite finding procedural lapses by the Equestrian Federation of India (EFI).A Bench of Justice Ahsanuddin Amanullah and Justice R Mahadevan agreed to list the matter for hearing on July 9 (Thursday) after senior counsel sought an urgent hearing.As the matter was mentioned, Justice Amanullah
